abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.

user.description: Do you want to set up Device Link Tools? It adds actions to link entities to a device, and creates no entities of its own.

device_id_composite.message: The device {device_id} was split between config entries and no longer exists under that id. Pick one of the resulting devices instead.

device_id_unknown.message: There is no device with the id {device_id}.

device_target_required.message: Give a device, its identifiers, or an entity already linked to it.

device_without_identifiers.message: The device {name} has no identifiers, so the link could not be restored after a restart.

entity_not_registered.message: {entity_id} has no entity registry entry, so it cannot be linked to a device. An entity only gets one when its integration gives it a unique ID; add a unique_id to its configuration and reload it.

identifiers_ambiguous.message: Several devices match the identifiers {identifiers}: {devices}. Use identifiers that only one of them carries.

link_refused.message: The entity registry refused to link {entity_id} to the device {device_id}, because that device id belongs to a device that was split between config entries. Use the identifiers of one of the resulting devices instead.

link_set_elsewhere.message: {entity_id} is linked to {name} by something other than this integration, so that link cannot be changed from here. A link an entity's own integration declares is written back on every restart; change it where it comes from.

source_not_linked.message: {entity_id} is not linked to any device, so there is no device to copy.

abort.entry_removed: Device Link Tools has been removed

error.invalid_device: That device cannot hold the link. Pick another one.

data_description.device_id: The device {entity_id} should be linked to.

select_device.description:
The device recorded for {entity_id} can no longer be identified, so the entity is not linked to any device.

Select the device it should be linked to, or leave empty to stop tracking it.
select_device.title: Select device for {entity_id}

unresolved_link.title: The device for {entity_id} needs to be selected again

abort.no_links: No entity is linked through Device Link Tools yet.

error.device_without_identifiers: That device has no identifiers, so the link could not be restored after a restart.

error.invalid_device: The entities could not be linked to that device.
error.link_set_elsewhere: One of the entities is linked to its device by something other than this integration, so that link cannot be changed from here.
